prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART character review board. Uniform neutral medium grey opaque backdrop. Exactly two columns: front-left full body and matching back-right full body of SAME person per row. Different rows are independent people, no interaction. Compact stocky game sprite proportions and conspicuously chunky square pixel clusters, simple 3-tone clothing, selective dark outline, small simple faces. Muted earth wool, linen and worn leather; simple medieval round/tie neck cuts. No modern lapels, suits, uniforms, medical symbols, fantasy ornament, magic, text, labels, border, scenery, agreement, payment or resolved quest. All appearance, hair, exact age, and gender where source unspecified are proposals, not narrative canon. No invented injuries or diagnoses. Native grid, palette, animation and runtime unverified. TWO rows. TOP JONHE mature female longstanding vine grower and provider of original vine stock, grey braid, dark olive dress and faded tan apron, empty hands at belt. BOTTOM SAIFU adult female relocated trial grower, short dark hair under dull russet kerchief, muted blue work dress and brown apron, a loosely coiled ordinary plant-tying cord at belt, empty hands. Different silhouettes. No uprooted vines, harvest, relocation or property transfer; no guaranteed fertile crop.
